SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Listenin g and Speakin g 8.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary, part of THE FARM – ANIMAL SAFETY AND CARE Suggested Vocabulary veterinary, poisonous, cr in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade six ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: Why do we tell riddles and proverbs? 2) How are riddles different from proverbs?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. recognise the difference between riddles and proverbs,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Listenin g and Speakin g 8.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary in the Kenya CBC curriculum.

   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.
